description: GPU smoke (B200) for the scan_mode selector: chunk_parallel vs serial via the public forward_chunked_scan. Correctness = agreement with serial (fp32, rel to output scale); fp64 algebra pinned by test_chunk_parallel_scan_replica. Speedup = t_serial / t_chunk_parallel.
finding: chunk_parallel matches serial to ~2-3e-7 of scale (essentially exact fp32) and is the long-L/under-saturated lever (5.05x at b2/L16384/d1024); serial wins when SM-saturated (0.71x at b8/L2048/d2048). The shape-dependent crossover is the >1 reward signal a shape-aware mode selector / config-RL action can learn.
